title: Refuse invisible and text-direction characters in customer names and file names?
bluf: A customer name can contain hidden or text-direction characters (even a name of only U+200B), and the client sees and prints it. The same family: file-name checks refuse some names Windows allows (LPT plus superscript 4). Recommend: refuse invisible, control and direction characters in customer names, as comments already do, and for file names fold width and white space only (stops the over-refusals). Default if you do not tap: option C (change nothing), at 10:00 AEDT today (2026-11-10). Tickets: HPSMPOC-178, HPSMPOC-324, HPSMPOC-257

options.label: Refuse in names; file names fold width/space only
options.detail: Settles 178, 324, 257. Agent builds with tests that fail first.

options.label: Refuse in names; leave file names as built
options.detail: Over-refusal of a few odd names stays.
